description: This file contains the definition of the Order class within the Opencart system, responsible for handling email notifications related to orders. It includes methods for constructing order-related emails, retrieving order info, managing order status updates, and assembling email data such as address formatting, product details, and subscription information.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: This class manages email notifications and order updates in the OpenCart system. It extends the core Controller class and provides functionality to generate detailed order emails, handle order status changes, and include product, address, and subscription information.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry that processes order information based on route arguments; prepares data for email templates and triggers email sending.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new order status change, handling product download links, address formatting, and subscription details, and assembles the email content.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Handles order history updates, including changing order statuses, managing email notifications, and assembling email content with detailed order and subscription information.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Handles alert event for order updates, constructing and sending email notifications for order status changes, including detailed order and subscription data.
